function.name: execute_code
function.description: Execute JavaScript code in isolated sandbox with pre-bound tool functions. Supports async/await and parallel tool calls. Requires anthropic-beta: advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20 header.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. Available bindings: call_tool(name, params), get_causal_path(query), get_ucpt_proof()

input_examples.code: const result = await call_tool('auditSite', {url: 'https://example.com'}); return result.score;
const [graph, citation] = await Promise.all([call_tool('getGraph', {url: 'https://site.com'}), call_tool('predictCitation', {url: 'https://site.com', platform: 'Claude'})]); return {graph, citation};
const path = await get_causal_path('machine learning best practices'); const proof = await get_ucpt_proof(); return {path, proof};
